title: Retired CFGI launcher lab-gate contract drift
objective: Update the historical altseason lab gate so it validates the ratified terminal no-retry lifecycle instead of requiring the retired five-minute recovery launcher schedule, while preserving every paid-data, budget, no-lookahead and provider-terminal safety assertion.

origin.thread_label: Post Master Monday W34 production integrity audit

evidence.summary: Historical Altseason Lab Gate failed on PR 563 solely because it still asserted the removed five-minute cron and legacy launch token in the retired recovery launcher. All preceding scientific, authorization and terminal budget assertions passed.
The bounded CFGI terminal-lifecycle repair remains unmerged because this stale gate assertion is red.
Fresh control-plane main used for routing.

forbidden_changes: any paid request or automatic paid retry
weakening no-lookahead or terminal provider assertions
reproduction: Run Historical Altseason Lab Gate at PR 563 head 9395aa495696bade6f4e4322ed4d1b92efed2120. The provider-bounded v3.1 contract block passes, then the split compute-publish block fails at the assertion that cfgi-recovery-launch-once.yml contains cron */5 and V3_MARKET_GAPFILL_RUN_BOUND even though the launcher was intentionally retired after the terminal provider receipt.

positive: The gate accepts the ratified RETIRED terminal/no-retry launcher lifecycle.
The gate still verifies terminal receipt, no additional paid retry, cumulative ledger, no-lookahead and provider-bounded readiness contracts.
PR 563 gates can complete without restoring a schedule.
negative: A live or scheduled paid recovery path after terminalization must fail.
Missing terminal receipt or weakened budget/no-lookahead assertions must fail.
The repair must not change research or market semantics.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main no longer requires the retired cron or PR 563 is superseded by an equivalent merged repair with all relevant gates green.
stop_condition: Stop if the change would reactivate the launcher, issue a paid request, weaken terminal/budget/no-lookahead safety or exceed the bounded gate contract.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if the correction requires new provider, budget, market or portfolio semantics.
rollback_plan: Revert only the lab-gate assertion update. Preserve terminal receipts, ledgers and the retired launcher state.
